name: agent-flow-trace
description: A workbench tab that displays and records how tasks and artifacts flow between the agents of a project: a live flow graph, an event timeline and an artifact ledger, exportable as JSON, JSONL or Markdown.

penguin.title: Agent Flow Trace
penguin.description_zh: 在 Agent 对话旁的工作台标签页中，显示并记录项目内多个智能体之间的任务派发与产物流转轨迹：实时流转图、事件时间线与产物台账，可一键导出 JSON / JSONL / Markdown 报告。
penguin.short_description: Display and record multi-agent task and artifact flows in a workbench tab.
penguin.short_description_zh: 在工作台中显示并记录多智能体间的任务与产物流转轨迹。
